ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: The 14th Amendment and the Evolution of Individual Rights Analyzes individual rights guaranteed by the 14th Amendment, including equal protection, fundamental rights, and substantive and procedural due process. We will trace the evolution of the Court’s interpretation of individual rights to understand how these rights are protected today as well as how they may evolve in the future. Restricted to Political Science majors until November 13, 2017.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
